## Windows folders like Spotify
Streyn now keeps its files on Windows the same way Spotify does. Your files of earlier versions move over by themselves on the first start, nothing is lost and you do not have to do anything.

| Spotify | Streyn | What is in it |
|---|---|---|
| `%APPDATA%\Spotify\Spotify.exe` | `%APPDATA%\Streyn\Streyn.exe` | the program (plus `streyn-server.exe` for offline mode) |
| `%APPDATA%\Spotify\prefs` | `%APPDATA%\Streyn\prefs` | settings of the desktop app (server address) |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Spotify\Storage` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Streyn\Storage` | offline downloads (songs and their database) |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Spotify\Browser` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Streyn\Browser` | the app's web data: sign-in, language, theme |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Spotify\Data` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Streyn\Data` | cache (downloaded updates) |

- **Moved, not copied:** settings, offline downloads and the sign-in are renamed into the new folders on the first start, so they take no extra space. The old folders `de.labtoso.streyn` disappear once they are empty
- **Old program files removed:** the setup removes `Streyn.exe` and `streyn-server.exe` from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Streyn` (that folder now only holds data). Start menu, Desktop and a Streyn pinned to the taskbar point to the new place
- **Uninstall like Spotify:** removes the program and its shortcuts, `prefs` and your offline downloads stay for a reinstall

## Install
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates → Update (or download `Streyn.exe` and run it). It moves everything by itself
- **Server, Android, Linux:** nothing changes
